snippet.title: The Midnight Walkers - Gamescom Gameplay Trailer (New Zombie Game)
snippet.description:
Hello survivors!
We're hard at work preparing for the upcoming Play Test in October, and this time we'll be at Gamescom 2024!
In honor of Gamescom, we're releasing a new gameplay trailer showcasing what we've been working on so far. 
Thank you!
